# Problem 1

```{r}

data("ny_noaa")
```

This dataset from the NOAA displays daily observed weather from all New York State weather stations, January 1, 1981 to December 31, 2010. The seven key variables include the station ID, date, precipitation, snowfall, snow depth, daily temperature high, and daily temperature low. The table dimensions are `r nrow(ny_noaa)` by `r ncol(ny_noaa)`, with all data missing in the first ten rows.

```{r}

ny_noaa_df = 
  ny_noaa |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  mutate(
    year = year(date),    # e.g., 2007
    month = month(date),  # 1-12
    day = day(date),     # 1-31
    prcp = prcp / 10,
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10
  )
```
